models.name: Hall-sensor battery monitor 5–120 V, ±400 A, no shunt ("No need Shunt" split-core / Hall current sensor head; matches Amazon ASIN B01LC5UXR6)

gotchas: No vendor manual for the Hall variant was located, and nothing in Baiway's published catalogue or download index corresponds to a 5–120 V ±400 A Hall head. No source states a communications interface, so none is recorded.

Do not assume it shares the TF03K frame because the display looks similar. The current front end is entirely different — a Hall sensor rather than a shunt — which is exactly the kind of product-line fork that gets a new firmware and a new link.
Independent of protocol: a Hall sensor has offset drift with temperature and needs periodic zeroing. Even if a link were found, the current figure would be the weakest number in the cabin.
